evidence.AC1: POST /todos with {"title":"past","dueDate":"2026-10-14"} returned 201 with dueDate "2026-10-14". A todo created without dueDate returned 201 with dueDate null. The value is a date only, with no time.
evidence.AC2: PATCH /todos/4 {"dueDate":"2026-01-02"} returned 200 with the date set. A PATCH that only changed the title kept the date. PATCH {"dueDate":null} returned 200 with dueDate null, so the date was removed.
evidence.AC3: POST with dueDate "2026-02-30", "15.10.2026" and "garbage" each returned 400. PATCH with "2026-02-30" and "foo" each returned 400.
evidence.AC4: Today is 2026-10-15 UTC. Test todos: due yesterday (open), due today, due in the future, no date, and an open-then-done todo due 2026-01-01. GET /todos?overdue=true returned only the todo due 2026-10-14. The todo due today, the future one, the one with no date and the done one were excluded.
evidence.AC5: The page at / listed "past · fällig 2026-10-14", "today · fällig 2026-10-15", "future · fällig 2026-12-01" and "pastdone ✓ · fällig 2026-01-01". The todo without a date showed no due date.
evidence.AC6: In the page snapshot only the open todo due 2026-10-14 had "überfällig". The todos due today, in the future, with no date, and the done past one had no marker.
